title: PowerPoint for Mac: modernised Presenter View with a single control bar
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned Mac redesign and November 2026 roadmap target. Searches confirmed the documented gaps around its default, feature-specific licensing and administrative switch; the statement about delaying other changes needs one additional Microsoft citation.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn has no page describing this modernized Presenter View.

claims.claim: The per-app preference page lists one PowerPoint key, CustomerLoggingEnabled.
claims.quote:
### CustomerLoggingEnabled
Enable verbose logging for Customer Support escalations.
| **Domain** | `com.microsoft.word`, `com.microsoft.excel`, `com.microsoft.powerpoint`, `com.microsoft.onenote.mac`, `com.microsoft.outlook` |

claims.claim: CustomerLoggingEnabled governs verbose logging for support, not Presenter View.
claims.quote: This key enables verbose mode logging for Customer Support escalations. It also places the Diagnostic logs in the device’s Documents folder for easier access.

claims.claim: Delaying an Office for Mac app update also delays the other changes in that update.
claims.quote: Individual security updates or other updates can't be downloaded and installed. Instead, Microsoft provides a new app bundle of an app, such as Word, that includes all the updates.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/mac/deploy-updates-for-office-for-mac to sources to support the sentence 'Delaying an update also delays the other changes it carries.'
